/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
LOCK=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
while ! mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null
do
  if [ -f "$LOCK" ]
  then
    rm -f "$LOCK"
    continue
  fi
  holder=$(cat "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$holder" ] && ! kill -0 "$holder" 2>/dev/null
  then
    rm -rf "$LOCK"
    continue
  fi
  if [ -z "$holder" ] && ! pgrep -f '"'lake build AlgebraicJacobian' >/dev/null 2>&1
  then
    age="'$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || date +%s) ))
    if [ "$age" -gt 900 ]
    then
      rm -rf "$LOCK"
      continue
    fi
  fi
  sleep 10
done
echo $$ > "$LOCK/pid"
cleanup() {
  if [ "$(cat "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$$" ]
  then
    rm -rf "$LOCK"
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
set -o pipefail
lake build AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepChartClassUnivAffRepresentable   2>&1 | tee /tmp/ajcr-param-universal-representable-retry.out'

LOCK=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
while ! mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null
do
  if [ -f "$LOCK" ]
  then
    rm -f "$LOCK"
    continue
  fi
  holder=$(cat "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$holder" ] && ! kill -0 "$holder" 2>/dev/null
  then
    rm -rf "$LOCK"
    continue
  fi
  if [ -z "$holder" ] && ! pgrep -f '"'lake build AlgebraicJacobian' >/dev/null 2>&1
  then
    age="'$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || date +%s) ))
    if [ "$age" -gt 900 ]
    then
      rm -rf "$LOCK"
      continue
    fi
  fi
  sleep 10
done
echo $$ > "$LOCK/pid"
cleanup() {
  if [ "$(cat "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$$" ]
  then
    rm -rf "$LOCK"
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
set -o pipefail
lake build AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepChartClassUnivAffRepresentable   2>&1 | tee /tmp/ajcr-param-universal-representable-retry2.out'

/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
LOCK=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
while ! mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null
do
  if [ -f "$LOCK" ]
  then
    rm -f "$LOCK"
    continue
  fi
  holder=$(cat "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$holder" ] && ! kill -0 "$holder" 2>/dev/null
  then
    rm -rf "$LOCK"
    continue
  fi
  if [ -z "$holder" ] && ! pgrep -f '"'lake build AlgebraicJacobian' >/dev/null 2>&1
  then
    age="'$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || date +%s) ))
    if [ "$age" -gt 900 ]
    then
      rm -rf "$LOCK"
      continue
    fi
  fi
  sleep 10
done
echo $$ > "$LOCK/pid"
cleanup() {
  if [ "$(cat "$LOCK/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$$" ]
  then
    rm -rf "$LOCK"
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
set -o pipefail
lake build AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepChartClassUnivAffRepresentable   2>&1 | tee /tmp/ajcr-param-universal-representable-retry3.out'
